description: This file defines the SaveClaimController class, which handles the pre-render logic for claim-related views in the OrangeHRM plugin. It dynamically sets the component to be used based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the HTTP request.

classes.name: SaveClaimController
classes.description: Handles preparation of claim view components for editing or creation based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering, setting it to either 'claim-event-edit' or 'claim-event-create' based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
